# MWP Shop: notes for Claude

shop.mw.photography. A static site on GitHub Pages, with Supabase, Make.com and monday.com behind it. Every push to `main` goes live within a few minutes.

## People and approvals
- Matan (owner) approves all copy, design, prices, refunds and terms. Jeinna builds and runs the shop.
- Claude drafts only. Nothing goes to customers and no price or term changes without Matan's explicit OK.
- Don't invent facts, numbers or product details. Check the sales pages or ask.

## Generated files: edit the source, not the output
- `index.html` is generated by `tools/build_home.py` (with `tools/home_try.py` for the "Try it yourself" section). Edit those files, then run `python3 tools/build_home.py`.
- `shop.html`, `product.html`, `account.html`, `support.html`, `legal.html`, `thank-you.html` and `404.html` are generated by `tools/build_pages.py`. Run `python3 tools/build_pages.py .`.
- `presets/`, `panel/` and `field-guides/` are Matan's sales-page designs. `tools/unify_pages.py` gives them the home page's header, gold colours and RAW/FINAL slider labels (run it again after replacing a page). To bring in updated designs, save the canvases' `.dc.html` files and run `python3 tools/import_designs.py <folder>`; it swaps image links, adds the runtime and runs unify_pages.py. Keep their content and layout as designed unless Matan asks.
- Brand colours live in `tools/brand.py` (gold from mw.photography). Use them everywhere, never the designs' original orange.
- Fonts: Google Sans for English, Heebo for Hebrew, on every page (`FONTS` in `tools/brand.py`, added by the build scripts). Don't introduce other typefaces.

## Language
- English and Hebrew everywhere. Matan's rule: on the Hebrew site **everything** is Hebrew, names included. The one exception: **MWP always stays in Latin letters**, everywhere (pages, the beta page, terms, PDFs), never אם־דבליו־פי (Matan, 13 Oct 2026). Product names: הפריסטים / הפאנל / מדריכי השטח של MWP. App and company names are written in Hebrew too (פוטושופ, לייטרום, למון סקוויזי …). What stays in Latin letters: file types (PDF, RAW, LUT, JPEG, XMP, DNG, zip), keyboard shortcuts, the email address, the Instagram handle and hashtags, and the EN switch.
- Hebrew text comes from the `HE` dictionary in `assets/js/i18n.js`, keyed by the exact English text. After that, the names list (`NAMES` in i18n.js, the same as `tools/he_names.py`) turns every name into Hebrew, on every element (including `data-no-i18n` ones). When you add or change English text on a page, add the matching Hebrew entry.
- The Hebrew setting (`mwp_lang`) also sends visitors to Matan's Hebrew sales pages (`presets/he.html` …); `tools/unify_pages.py` adds that and runs `tools/sales_he.py` (names + `EXACT` translations) on those pages.
- The Ambassador terms have a Hebrew version (`TERMS_HE` in `tools/ambassador_terms.py`, needs Matan's review). People who accept in Hebrew get a Hebrew signed copy (`terms_pdf_he.py`, `beta_members.terms_lang`).

## Prices on the home and sales pages
- Every price spot is `<span data-price="slug">` and shows the price set for that product in the admin (`assets/js/lib/prices.js`, reading the `page_prices` view). English shows the dollar price, Hebrew the shekel price. With no price set, it shows $0.00 / ₪0.00.
- Product slugs: mwp-presets, mwp-panel, mwp-field-guides, presets-field-guides, presets-panel, field-guides-panel, full-set.
- On the sales pages, `PRICE_SLOTS` in `tools/unify_pages.py` lists the price spots in page order. Update it if a redesign adds or moves a price.

## Ambassador Program page (/beta/)
- `beta/index.html` is generated by `tools/build_beta.py` (script: `assets/js/pages/beta.js`). It's shared by link only: not linked from the site, not indexed, and there's no password.
- **By application (Matan, 13 Oct 2026).** The page is a single hero. It shows Matan's Ambassador Program terms word for word (`TERMS` in `tools/build_beta.py`) in a pop-up ("Read the terms and apply"), as one document to read through (a contents list, then every chapter), with Close and Accept in a bar at the bottom. Visitors accept them from the pop-up (step 1); only then does the questionnaire open, in a second closable pop-up (step 2: about you, photography, editing, values, the program). Sending it (`beta` → `apply`) gives nothing yet: it saves an `ambassador_applications` row and sends it to monday's **Shop Ambassador Applications** board (Make `type: "ambassador_application"`, all answers in the All answers column) and tells Matan.
- **Decisions are made in monday.** The team sets Decision = Approved or Declined. Every 10 minutes while applications wait, the scheduler (`applications`, see `supabase/functions/scheduler/applications.ts`) asks Make for the board and acts: Approved → `grantAmbassador()` (`_shared/ambassador.ts`: the tools, `beta_members`, Shop Ambassadors, signed-terms PDF) and the welcome email; Declined → the decline email; full → Shop result = Program full, no email. Make writes Shop result back and sends the email from contact@ (`application_decided`; the Gmail step exists only when `docs/make_blueprint.py` gets the Gmail connection id). The email texts (English / Hebrew, signed Emilya) live in `applications.ts`; change them only with Matan's OK.
- The old instant `join` is gone: there's no way to get the tools from this page without an approval. The approved person creates their account on My downloads with the same email.
- Change the terms only with Matan's OK, and bump `TERMS_VERSION` in both `tools/ambassador_terms.py` and `supabase/functions/beta/index.ts` when they change.
- Each approved ambassador gets a signed-terms PDF (`tools/personalize/terms_pdf.py`, made by the Personal copies worker): stored privately in the `documents` bucket and attached to the person's Shop Ambassadors row (Signed terms column) through Make (`ambassador_terms_pdf`). The form also asks for Instagram and Facebook.
- Approval gives that email MWP Presets, MWP Panel and the Field Guides (the guides read online only: `entitlements.view_only`), records them in `beta_members` (with the terms version and language they accepted when applying), and sends them to monday.com's Shop Ambassadors board (`type: "ambassador"`). Applications are limited to 5 an hour per IP; a second application from the same email while one waits is answered "We already have your application".
- The program takes 26 people at most (`ambassador_cap()` in the database; a trigger on `beta_members` enforces it, even for simultaneous joins). When it's full, the page shows "The Ambassador Program is full" and joining is refused; existing members can still rejoin. To change the number, replace `ambassador_cap()` in a new migration.
- Signed terms: made after approval; it sits in My downloads ("Your Ambassador Program terms", `beta` → `signed_terms`, signed in).
- Field Guides for ambassadors: `read.html` (script `read.js`, function `guide-view`). The worker renders each guide version's pages once into the private `guide-pages` bucket (`views/<product>/<version>/`; the `presets` bucket only takes zips); the reader shows the pages without a watermark (Jeinna's call). It shows only the guides in the page's language (each guide's `lang` is worked out by the worker from its file name or text), with a guide picker, Scroll mode (scrolling, no arrows) or Page by page (previous / next arrows on either side of the page, arrow keys and swipe; scrolling over the pages is off), and a full-screen button on each page (lower right). Guide titles come from the PDF's title or its cover text, in its own language. `get-download` refuses view-only copies. Buying the guides (alone or in a bundle) makes them downloadable.
- Signed-in ambassadors land on My downloads when they arrive at the home or beta page (once per visit; `assets/js/lib/landing.js`).
- Ambassadors can use MWP Panel on 2 computers (buyers get 3): `AMBASSADOR_MAX_DEVICES` in the `license` function.
- Ending an ambassadorship: admin → Ambassadors → End (they keep their licence for life, terms section 7) or End (breach) (their free access is removed; anything they bought stays). `end_ambassador()` in the database does it (admins only) and the scheduler tells Make, which updates Shop Ambassadors (status, end date, a note). Ended members still count toward the 26 places.

## Testers page (/testers/)
- Link-only page for testers (at most 10 active: `tester_cap()`, enforced by a trigger on `testers`). Testers join by themselves with the **tester code**: name + email + code on the page → `tester` `join` → `add_tester_by_code`, and they're signed in on the page at once: no email step (the function makes their login and returns a one-time token the page turns into a session). Emails that are the admin's, a buyer's or an ambassador's never get signed in by the code: they get an emailed link instead. 5 tries an hour per IP. No approval step (Matan, 13 Oct 2026). The code is set and shown in admin → Testers (`tester_code`: the code, readable by admins only, plus its SHA-256 that the function checks; saving a new one replaces it). Remove in admin (`remove_tester`).
- An approved tester gets MWP Presets, MWP Panel and the Field Guides as downloads, with the same protection as buyers (stamped personal copies made at approval, 5-minute links, daily limit; Panel on 2 computers). They sign in on the page with a one-time email link (the `tester` function only sends links to approved emails). Removing takes back the free access (purchases stay; an active ambassador keeps the program's access).
- Both actions go to monday's Shop Testers board (scheduler job `tester` → Make `type: "tester"`).

## Accounts
- Customers and ambassadors have an MWP account: email + password (Supabase Auth), used across the whole shop. My downloads (`account.html`) has Sign in / Create account, Forgot password (emailed reset link, then "Choose a new password"), and "Email me a sign-in link" as a fallback. `?next=/path` returns them there after signing in; `?mode=signup` opens Create account.
- New accounts must confirm their email before signing in (the deploy workflow's "Account safety settings" step enforces this and an 8-character minimum). Without it, someone could open an account on another person's email and see their purchases. Don't turn it off.
- My details (on My downloads, `#details`; "My details" in the account menu when signed in): name, phone and country (no address: Matan, 13 Oct 2026; an address saved earlier is kept as it is), read and saved through `my_profile()` / `save_my_profile()` (migration `20261013000017`), only for the signed-in person's own confirmed email. The email itself isn't editable there (purchases are tied to it); changes go through support.
- Passwords go only from the browser to Supabase Auth. Never send them to our functions, Make or monday.
- Add to cart on the home and sales pages: their buy buttons (links to `#buy` and the buttons in the `.plan` bundle cards) add that product to the cart and open it (`addSlugToCart` in `cart.js`). The product comes from the price card the button sits in, else the nearest price in its section, else the button's words, else the page's product. Names, prices and checkout links come from the public `page_prices` view. If a redesign moves a buy button, check it still adds the right product.
- Checkout needs an account: every checkout link carries `data-checkout`, and `cart.js` shows "Create your account first" in the cart until they're signed in, then sends them to checkout with their account email.
- Approved ambassadors create their account on My downloads with the email they applied with (the welcome email says so); if it already has an account, the tools simply appear in it.

## Personal copies (Presets and Field Guides)
- Each buyer and beta member downloads their own marked copy: their name, email and licence ID on every PDF page, and in a comment inside every .xmp and .cube file (`tools/personalize/personalize.py`).
- The "Personal copies" workflow (`.github/workflows/personalize.yml`, `tools/personalize/worker.py`) makes missing or outdated copies into `presets/personal/<entitlement>/` and records them in `personal_files`. Until a copy exists, `get-download` answers 202 "preparing" and My downloads waits for it.
- It runs instantly when the `PERSONALIZE_TOKEN` secret is set (a GitHub token that can trigger this repo's workflows), otherwise hourly. Uploading a new version of a product file makes everyone's copy again.
- MWP Panel isn't stamped; its licence sign-in protects it.

## MWP Panel in Photoshop and Photoshop (Beta)
- Both apps keep separate plugin storage, so `tools/panel-license/license.js` works out the device id from the computer, and the `license` function counts a computer already listed under the same name once. The plugin's manifest needs no `maxVersion` (see `tools/panel-license/README.md`).

## Cart and header icons
- `assets/js/lib/cart.js` adds the two header icons on every page: Account (a menu with who is signed in, My downloads, Help and sign in / sign out) and Cart. The sales pages ship the same two icons from `tools/unify_pages.py`.

## monday.com sync (what goes there automatically)
- One Make scenario ("MWP Shop · Events to monday", id 7886122, webhook = `MAKE_WEBHOOK_URL`) routes every event by `type`. Its blueprint is generated by `docs/make_blueprint.py` (board and column ids in `docs/monday-map.json`); edit the generator, never the scenario by hand only.
- Events: `order` → Shop Orders + Shop Customers · `refund`/`partial_refund` → order status · `support` → Shop Support (+ tells Matan about refund requests) · `subscribe` → Shop Customers (newsletter) · `product` → Shop Products · `approvals_request` → Matan's approvals back to the shop · `weekly_summary` → Shop Reports · `payout` → Shop Payouts · `ambassador` → Shop Ambassadors (+ tells Matan) · `account` (email confirmed) → Shop Customers, source Account / Ambassador program · `downloaded` (first download) → order Delivery = Downloaded · `ambassador_status` (ended in the admin) → Shop Ambassadors status and end date · `ambassador_terms_pdf` (from the worker) → the signed terms attached on Shop Ambassadors · `tester` (approved / removed in the admin, or joined with the code) → Shop Testers · `ambassador_application` → Shop Ambassador Applications (+ tells Matan) · `applications_request` → that board back to the shop (decisions) · `application_decided` → Shop result, and the welcome / decline email.
- Make can reject formulas the module checker accepts (a `replace()` with a regex switched the scenario off once). Keep mappings to plain `{{1.field}}` references and clean data in the shop's functions instead. After every blueprint upload, check the next run in Make's history.

## Clean addresses
- Every page also lives at a clean address: /account/, /shop/, /product/?p=…, /support/, /legal/, /thank-you/, /read/, /testers/, and /presets/he/ (etc.) for the Hebrew sales pages. `build_pages.py` and `unify_pages.py` write these copies (with `<base href>` so relative links still work); the old .html addresses keep working. Link to the clean addresses in new code. The deploy workflow copies these folders.

## Fresh scripts
- On every deploy, `tools/stamp_scripts.py` stamps each page's scripts with a version (`?v=`) and adds an import map so every imported script (api.js, cart.js, i18n.js …) is versioned too. This stops browsers mixing an old cached script with new code, which blanks pages. It runs on the published copy only; nothing to do by hand.

## Before pushing
- Serve the site locally (`python3 -m http.server`) and check the changed pages in English and Hebrew, on desktop and phone widths.
- Work on a branch and merge to `main` only when it's ready to go live.
